selection_semantics.enumeration: For each fixed meeting enumerate day_index 01..04 and race_no 01..12; retain every race whose mandatory PRE parse and confirmed closing-price parse both pass; no replacement after settlement access.
selection_semantics.validation_collision_gate: Validation meetings must have zero overlap with all probability-model development/validation meetings and must postdate the immutable DEV2000 universe creation; any collision fails closed.

purchase_policy_family.description: Low-degree-of-freedom redesign informed only by the already-burned DEV2000 postmortem: suppress extreme longshot concentration and require conservative agreement between validated NL2 and frozen B1a.

validation_gate.C5_bootstrap: 10000 whole-race bootstrap replicates, seed 20260913, 95% ROI lower bound > 0
validation_gate.POSITIVE_BUT_UNCERTAIN: coverage and C1-C4 pass but C5 fails
validation_gate.FAIL: coverage passes and any of C1-C4 fails

phase_firewall: Development PRE and PRICE are parsed before development SETTLEMENT scoring.
Validation meeting identities are frozen in this preregistration before development settlement scoring.
The selected development policy must be atomically persisted before any validation target is fetched.
Validation PRE/PRICE and ticket decisions are frozen before validation SETTLEMENT parser invocation.
No validation-derived retune, replacement, threshold change, market change, deletion, or rescue scoring is allowed.
No DEV2000 RESULT/PAYOUT and no ECON_HOLDOUT1000 bytes may be opened by this lineage.
scientific_claim_boundary: Even PASS is historical KR-015 economics evidence only. It does not authorize Runtime, live orders, automatic betting, or real-money wagering.
